name: Stripe Invoice Payments Sample
brief: Sample extension: customers pay posted sales invoices through Stripe Checkout, Business Central posts and applies the payment.
description: Sample BC extension for online invoice payments. Creates a Stripe Checkout payment page for an open posted sales invoice, polls Stripe from a job queue and posts the customer payment applied to the invoice. Every Stripe call is logged, and a failed posting never stops the run: the link is marked Failed and can be posted again.
